threat_event: Unpublished client vulnerability findings leak from the findings vault or collaboration tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Findings copied into a collaboration space shared with Medical Devices engineers
likelihood_basis: EV-072 (shared collaboration space); EV-073 (separate vault account and per-client keys)
existing_controls: Separate account and keys; per-client encryption
treatment_plan: Close the shared space; data loss prevention on findings; access monitoring

threat_event: Competitor design data submitted for testing reaches Medical Devices staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Barrier not enforced in SYS-G1 groups or collaboration tools
likelihood_basis: EV-072 (212 Medical Devices engineers; no barrier groups in SYS-G1)
treatment_plan: Barrier groups in SYS-G1; quarterly attestations; SOC alerts on cross-division access

threat_event: Malware from a client device under test escapes the test range
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Range isolated; data leaves only through the vault
likelihood_basis: EV-079 (range isolated; data leaves only through the vault)

threat_event: Client-submitted device logs contain PHI that Testing is not set up to protect
likelihood_basis: EV-076 (3 PHI cases in 2026; no intake scanning)
regulatory_driver: N62-R01 (if held for a business associate client); state breach laws
treatment_plan: Automated scanning and quarantine at intake

threat_event: An attacker compromises the local directory at an acquired laboratory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA only for remote access; not federated to SYS-G1
likelihood_basis: EV-071 (local directory; MFA only for remote access)

threat_event: Testing misses a client notice duty after an incident affecting client data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NDA notice terms not in the notification matrix
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (NDA terms not in the draft matrix); EV-074 (NDA notice duties)
treatment_plan: Add client NDA notice terms to the matrix (P08)

threat_event: Test results in the LIMS are altered
The generative AI report drafting tool processes client confidential data without client consent terms
likelihood_basis: EV-078 (pilot since 2026-02 without client consent terms)
treatment_plan: Client consent clause; restrict to consenting clients (P10)

threat_event: Clients or FDA question independence of tests Testing performs for Medical Devices
treatment_plan: Independence statement for every intercompany engagement

likelihood_basis: EV-071 (separate directory at acquired laboratories); EV-018 (EDR coverage); EV-079 (daily backups)

threat_event: A client portal account is taken over
Client EAR-controlled technical data is released to foreign-national staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client data not tagged for export control at intake
likelihood_basis: EV-097 (client data not tagged for export control at intake); EV-032 (staff screening)
treatment_plan: Export tag at intake; staffing check

threat_event: Client test data is lost because a backup fails
likelihood_basis: EV-079 (daily backups; no restore test recorded in 2026)

threat_event: A stolen laboratory laptop exposes client data
